title: Chat/set missing receiptSharing in updatable patch keys
description:
Location: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md, Chat Methods / Chat/set / Updating a Chat, line ~862.

The spec defines Chat.receiptSharing as an optional Boolean field (per-chat override of the account-level preference) that is owner-side and not shared with peers. However, the Chat/set 'update' section lists only 'muted', 'muteUntil', 'receiveTypingIndicators', 'pinnedMessageIds', and 'messageExpirySeconds' as updatable patch keys. The 'receiptSharing' field is omitted.

Because RFC 8620 Section 5.3 requires that servers reject updates to unlisted fields, the per-chat receiptSharing override cannot be set or changed by clients at all.

Correct behavior: 'receiptSharing' MUST be listed among the supported update patch keys in Chat/set.
close_reason: Fixed: receiptSharing added to Chat/set patch keys (chat-00.md:862)
